svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: Five limits: read first
svg.desc: Five numbered technical limits. Pure TUN mode gets nothing written, which is correct behaviour; disconnected is not the same as quitting, traffic decides; moving outside the search range needs one manual install to take over; previously hand-set user proxy variables are snapshotted first and restored on uninstall; security software may treat it as suspicious and block the scripts, so allow it or whitelist it.

g.text: Pure TUN gets nothing: correct, leave it alone
Disconnected is not quit: traffic decides
Moved out of range: install once by hand
Hand-set variables are snapshotted, restored on uninstall
Security software may block the scripts: allow or whitelist
